title: Geophysics
description: Geophysical grids - magnetometry, resistivity, GPR time slices, EM - imported from Surfer GRD, XYZ/CSV, GeoTIFF or folders of slices, georeferenced with the markers or the pegs' coordinates, filtered (despike, destripe, high-pass, clip, fill), overlaid on the orthomosaic and the DEM with opacity, exported as GeoTIFF, Surfer GRD and GeoPackage, into the QGIS project

it.title: Geofisica
it.description: Griglie geofisiche - magnetometria, resistività, time slice GPR, EM - importate da Surfer GRD, XYZ/CSV, GeoTIFF o cartelle di slice, georeferenziate con i marker o le coordinate dei picchetti, filtrate (despike, destripe, passa-alto, clip, riempimento), sovrapposte a ortofoto e DEM con opacità, esportate in GeoTIFF, Surfer GRD e GeoPackage, nel progetto QGIS
